description.content: Status can be ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, NO_LONGER_ORDERED, NOT_FOR_SALE
Get Assortment's Products Link Data only for active links.  Status can be ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, NO_LONGER_ORDERED, NOT_FOR_SALE
Add Product to Assortment. Status can be ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, NO_LONGER_ORDERED, NOT_FOR_SALE
Add Products to Assortment in bulk.  Status can be ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, NO_LONGER_ORDERED, NOT_FOR_SALE

Get Assortment's Products Data with total count. The assortment to product link status is in the `linkStatus` field under each product's data.
The `linkStatus` field is filterable and sortable.  Status can be ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, NO_LONGER_ORDERED, NOT_FOR_SALE
The `product_name_in_assortment` field is filterable.  just put [['product_name_in_assortment.en','=','bla-bla-bla'],'or','product_name_in_assortment.fr','=','yada-yada]
the 'and' operand is not supported for the  `product_name_in_assortment`

query.description: the sort parameter is explained in the `Filtering & Sorting` section on top of the Swagger documentation
the filter parameter is explained in the `Filtering & Sorting` section on top of the Swagger documentation
optionally return total number of records in the X-Total-Count response header

header.description: total number of records (ignores skip & take parameters)

info.name: assignments Assortment Assortment To Product Linking API

description.content:
## Overview



This application offers an API for managing assignments and tasks.



GraphQL endpoint for the same API is [also available](/graph)



<details><summary>Authentication</summary>



> 

> Authenticate using your Erply credentials and get a sessionKey. This sessionKey and your Erply clientCode must be provided in the HTTP headers of every request. You do not have to authenticate against this API - valid Erply sessionKey-s from other sources are also acceptable. To authenticate using this API, use the `POST /api/v1/auth` endpoint.

>

</details>
